rule: The fixture stores the SHA-256 digest of each literal, sorted, and never the literal. A code literal is any token in a scanned file that is one word of two or more characters in capitals, digits and single underscores, with a non-word character on both sides. Files with these extensions: cjs, cts, js, json, jsx, mjs, mts, py, rs, sh, toml, ts, tsx, yaml, yml. Lockfiles, node_modules, dist, .git, markdown, and packages/gauge-errors are not scanned. Tests are. A token shaped like an AKIA or ASIA access key id (20 characters), or made only of 0-9 and A-F with 16 or more characters, is skipped. See packages/gauge-errors/tools/existing-literals.mjs.
